name: memory_correct
description: Fix or forget something Houge remembers (episodic facts; wiki pages can only be retired). Use it ONLY when Paco asks you to correct or forget something you remember. Always call action "search" first with a short query and pick ids from that result: retire and correct accept only ids that a search in this same turn returned. Prefer "correct" with Paco's corrected wording (in his words, one self-contained sentence) whenever he says what is true instead; use "retire" when the memory is simply wrong or unwanted. At most 5 ids per call and 10 changed rows per turn. Every retire and correct waits for Paco to tap Approve on a card showing exactly what changes; if he denies, leave the memory as it is. He also gets an Undo button for every change. If it refuses with tainted_turn, tell Paco to ask again in a fresh message.
